rules.name: Reconcile comparable forecasts and scenarios
rules.purpose: Make financial changes reproducible and preserve missing inputs.
rules.applies_when: An earnings update has a supplied forecast packet.
rules.does_not_apply_when: Historical actuals, guidance, and consensus would have to be substituted for forecasts.
rules.on_missing: Mark the missing comparison incomplete; do not fill it from memory.
rules.confidence: Proposed generic finance procedure; not inferred from project reports.
